admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.subtitle: Your Path to Success Starts Here
admissions.desc: Join St. Austin's International University and unlock your potential. Our admissions process is designed to be straightforward and supportive.
admissions.requirementsDesc: To be considered for admission, applicants must meet the following requirements:
admissions.step1Desc: Complete our online application form with your personal and academic information.
admissions.step2Desc: Upload your transcripts, test scores, and letters of recommendation.
admissions.step3Desc: Our admissions team will review your application and schedule an interview.
admissions.step4Desc: Get your admission decision and enrollment information.
admissions.faqA1: We accept applications on a rolling basis. Apply as early as possible for better course availability.
admissions.faqA2: Tuition varies by program. Please contact our admissions team for detailed pricing.
admissions.faqQ3: When does the academic year start?
admissions.faqA3: The academic year typically starts in September. We also offer spring and summer intakes.
admissions.faqA4: Yes! We offer scholarships, grants, and flexible payment plans.

about.title: About St. Austin's International University
about.missionDesc: To empower individuals through accessible, high-quality education that bridges academic excellence with practical career readiness.
about.visionDesc: To be a global leader in career-focused higher education, recognized for innovation, inclusivity, and student success.
about.value1Desc: We maintain the highest standards in education and student outcomes
about.value2Desc: We make quality education available to all, regardless of background
about.value3Desc: We embrace modern teaching methods and cutting-edge technology
about.value4Desc: We foster a supportive and inclusive campus environment
about.historyDesc: Founded in 1995, St. Austin's International University has been dedicated to providing career-focused education for over 25 years. Starting as a small institution with just 50 students, we have grown to serve thousands of students annually while maintaining our commitment to personalized education and career success.
about.accreditationDesc: We are accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC).
